devex-mia: quick PSA — onboarding samplekit users hit a weird parity issue between js/python SDKs when using JSON mode + function/tool calls. reports that validator sometimes accepts top-level array vs object and then the SDK helper double-wraps it.
sdk-ryan: ugh. can you paste minimal repro?
devex-mia: repro in sampleapp -> call to /runTool with schema: expects {id: string, attrs: object} but model sometimes emits [ {id:..} ] when prompt includes 'return array if multiple' guidance. python sdk then does `jsonmode_helper.ensure_object(resp)` which wraps array into {items: [...]}. ts helper expects raw array and leaves as-is. consequences: downstream schema validation fails in our sample tests.
sam-dev: seeing this too during live demo today. quick fix was to add a tiny middleware in the samplekit that normalizes any array to first element, but that's not great.
infra-lee: hmm maybe the retry/auth wrapper is touching it? we did add safe-parse fallback in 1.8.2 that coerces into object when top-level isn't object. could be that.
sdk-ryan: that fallback was intended for broken json from the model, but it should be opt-in. looks like samplekit turns it on by default currently.
devex-mia: exact config in samplekit: ```json
{"sdk": {"jsonMode": true, "tolerate_broken_json": true, "fncall_helpers": {"coerce_arrays": true}}}
```
we should not enable tolerate_broken_json by default for onboarding.
sam-dev: agreed. for demos we want deterministic schemas. i pushed a small change to samplekit that sets tolerate_broken_json=false and adds a dev warning. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/412
sdk-ryan: nice. i'll also draft a parity test that runs the same prompt through py/ts helpers to assert identical normalized output. can someone add that to CI?
infra-lee: i'll add a job under devex-test matrix — can run on PRs.
devex-mia: another UX hole: the onboarding guide tells users to enable "loose parsing" to avoid crashes, which encourages this. we should reword the guide and add a note about schema-first expectations.
sam-dev: I'll update the docs. small suggested copy: "If you are using structured output (JSON mode + function/tool calls), prefer strict parsing during onboarding to avoid surprises; enable tolerant parsing only for legacy models."
sdk-ryan: also tagging deploy-bot to bump samplekit default version in quickstarts when the PR merges.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: samplekit quickstart package version will be bumped to 1.8.3 on merge. :white_check_mark:
devex-mia: ok action items: 1) merge PR 412 to set tolerate_broken_json off (sam) 2) add parity CI (ryan + lee) 3) update onboarding docs (sam) 4) monitor support queue for related tickets (mia).
sam-dev: on it.
sdk-ryan: i'll open the parity test issue and reference it in the PR.
infra-lee: queued CI job, ETA EOD.
devex-mia: thanks all. small note for onboarding: include a troubleshooting snippet showing how to explicitly normalize arrays if a user truly wants list semantics. snippet: ```js
// quick normalizer
function normalizeToolResult(res) {
  if (Array.isArray(res)) return {items: res};
  return res;
}
```
sam-dev: perfect. i'll add that example to the guide.
sdk-ryan: closing loop — i'll post a short changelog entry in #devex when parity CI is live.
devex-mia: great. this felt like a small DX footgun but easy fix. thanks everyone :tada:
